title: Ὁ Κῆπος καὶ Τὰ Ζῷα
subtitle: Unit 1, Chapter 2 — The Garden and the Animals

panels.scene: Teaches: κῆπος, ἐγγύς — The garden is near the house.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ κῆπος ἐγγύς ἐστιν τοῦ οἴκου.
panels.englishCaption: The garden is near the house.

panels.scene: Teaches: λάχανον — A vegetable grows in the garden.
panels.greekCaption: λάχανόν ἐστιν ἐν τῷ κήπῳ.
panels.englishCaption: A vegetable is in the garden.

panels.scene: Teaches: φυτεύω — The farmer plants the vegetable in the garden.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς φυτεύει τὸ λάχανον ἐν τῷ κήπῳ.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer plants the vegetable in the garden.

panels.scene: Teaches: λαμβάνω, ἐσθίω, ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ — He takes the vegetable and eats inside the house.
panels.greekCaption: λαμβάνει τὸ λάχανον καὶ ἐσθίει ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ.
panels.englishCaption: He takes the vegetable and eats in the house.

panels.scene: Teaches: δένδρον, μέγα — A great tree stands in the field.
panels.greekCaption: μέγα δένδρον ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ.
panels.englishCaption: A great tree is in the field.

panels.scene: Teaches: καρπός (plural) — Fruits are on the tree.
panels.greekCaption: καρποὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ δένδρου εἰσίν.
panels.englishCaption: Fruits are on the tree.

panels.scene: Teaches: κλάδος, ἐπί — The branches of the tree are great. The fruit hangs from the branches.
panels.greekCaption: οἱ κλάδοι τοῦ δένδρου μεγάλοι εἰσίν. ὁ καρπὸς ἐπὶ τοῖς κλάδοις ἐστίν.
panels.englishCaption: The branches of the tree are great. The fruit is on the branches.

panels.scene: Teaches: δρέπανον — This is a sickle.
panels.greekCaption: τοῦτό ἐστιν δρέπανον.
panels.englishCaption: This is a sickle.

panels.scene: Teaches: θερίζω, ἐκ — The farmer harvests the fruits from the tree with the sickle.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς θερίζει τοὺς καρποὺς ἐκ τοῦ δένδρου.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer harvests the fruits from the tree.

panels.scene: Teaches: ὄνος — The donkey is in the field.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ὄνος ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ.
panels.englishCaption: The donkey is in the field.

panels.scene: Teaches: φέρω, ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ — The donkey carries the stones out of the field.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ὄνος φέρει τοὺς λίθους ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The donkey carries the stones out of the field.

panels.scene: Teaches: βοῦς, μέγας, ἰσχυρός — The ox is great and strong.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ βοῦς μέγας καὶ ἰσχυρός ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: The ox is great and strong.

panels.scene: Teaches: πρόβατον, ζῷον — The sheep is an animal.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ πρόβατον ζῷόν ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: The sheep is an animal.

panels.scene: Teaches: ζῷα (plural) — The animals are in the field together.
panels.greekCaption: τὰ ζῷα ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ εἰσίν.
panels.englishCaption: The animals are in the field.

panels.scene: Teaches: πίνω, ἐκ τοῦ ποταμοῦ — The sheep drinks from the river.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ πρόβατον πίνει ἐκ τοῦ ποταμοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The sheep drinks from the river.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἀρνίον, τέκνον, μικρόν — The lamb is the child of the sheep.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ ἀρνίον τέκνον ἐστὶν τοῦ προβάτου. μικρόν ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: The lamb is the child of the sheep. It is small.

panels.scene: Teaches: τρέχω, ταχέως — The lamb runs quickly in the field.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ ἀρνίον τρέχει ταχέως ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ.
panels.englishCaption: The lamb runs quickly in the field.

panels.scene: Teaches: βλέπω, χαίρω — The farmer sees the sheep and the lamb and rejoices.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς βλέπει τὸ πρόβατον καὶ τὸ ἀρνίον καὶ χαίρει.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer sees the sheep and the lamb and rejoices.

panels.scene: Teaches: πέραν, θηρίον — A wild beast is lurking across the river.
panels.greekCaption: θηρίον ἐστὶν πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: A wild beast is across the river.

panels.scene: Teaches: λύκος — The wolf is across the river. His eyes are intent.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύκος ἐστὶν πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The wolf is across the river.

panels.scene: Teaches: πονηρός — The wolf is evil. He sees the small lamb.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύκος πονηρός ἐστιν. βλέπει τὸ μικρὸν ἀρνίον.
panels.englishCaption: The wolf is evil. He sees the small lamb.

panels.scene: Teaches: οὐ … βλέπει, contrast μέγας ↔ μικρόν — He does not see the great ox; he sees the small lamb.
panels.greekCaption: οὐ βλέπει τὸν μέγαν βοῦν· βλέπει τὸ μικρὸν ἀρνίον.
panels.englishCaption: He does not see the great ox; he sees the small lamb.

panels.scene: Teaches: φυλάσσω — The farmer stands guard between the river and the lamb. God guards the lamb.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς φυλάσσει τὸ ἀρνίον. ὁ θεὸς φυλάσσει αὐτό.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer guards the lamb. God guards it.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἡμέρα, reinforces καλῶς — A beautiful day. The whole farm is peaceful.
panels.greekCaption: ἡμέρα καλή ἐστιν. ὁ ἥλιος λάμπει ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ.
panels.englishCaption: It is a beautiful day. The sun shines in the sky.

panels.scene: Teaches: ῥέω, καλῶς — The river flows well.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ποταμὸς ῥεῖ καλῶς.
panels.englishCaption: The river flows well.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἔξω, ἡσυχάζω — The farmer sits outside the house and rests.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς καθίζει ἔξω τοῦ οἴκου καὶ ἡσυχάζει.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer sits outside the house and rests.

panels.scene: Reinforces: πέραν, βλέπει — The wolf stays across the river and watches.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύκος μένει πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ βλέπει.
panels.englishCaption: The wolf stays across the river and watches.

panels.scene: Teaches: θέλω, ἁρπάζω — The wolf wants to seize the lamb.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύκος θέλει ἁρπάζειν τὸ ἀρνίον.
panels.englishCaption: The wolf wants to seize the lamb.

panels.scene: Reinforces: οὐ βλέπουσιν — The sheep and the lamb do not see the wolf.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ πρόβατον καὶ τὸ ἀρνίον οὐ βλέπουσιν τὸν λύκον.
panels.englishCaption: The sheep and the lamb do not see the wolf.

panels.scene: Teaches: μέλλω, σῴζω — The farmer is about to save his animals.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς μέλλει σῴζειν τὰ ζῷα αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer is about to save his animals.

panels.scene: Teaches: καταλείπω, φεύγω — The good farmer does not abandon his animals and flee.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς ἀγαθός ἐστιν. οὐ καταλείπει τὰ ζῷα καὶ οὐ φεύγει.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer is good. He does not abandon his animals and does not flee.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἰδού, εἰς — Behold! The wolf runs into the river.
panels.greekCaption: ἰδού! ὁ λύκος τρέχει εἰς τὸν ποταμόν.
panels.englishCaption: Behold! The wolf runs into the river.

panels.scene: Reinforces: ἐκ, εἰς — The wolf comes out of the river into the field.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύκος ἐκβαίνει ἐκ τοῦ ποταμοῦ εἰς τὸν ἀγρόν.
panels.englishCaption: The wolf comes out of the river into the field.

panels.scene: Reinforces: ἐγγύς — The wolf is now near the lamb.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύκος ἐγγύς ἐστιν τοῦ ἀρνίου.
panels.englishCaption: The wolf is near the lamb.

panels.scene: Teaches: κράζω — The donkey hears the wolf and cries out with a loud voice.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ὄνος ἀκούει τὸν λύκον καὶ κράζει μεγάλῃ φωνῇ.
panels.englishCaption: The donkey hears the wolf and cries out with a loud voice.

panels.scene: Teaches: εὐθύς, ῥάβδος — Immediately the farmer takes his staff.
panels.greekCaption: εὐθὺς ὁ γεωργὸς λαμβάνει τὴν ῥάβδον αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: Immediately the farmer takes his staff.

panels.scene: Reinforces: λαμβάνω, λίθος — He also takes stones from the field.
panels.greekCaption: λαμβάνει καὶ λίθους ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
panels.englishCaption: He also takes stones from the field.

panels.scene: Teaches: φωνή — The farmer runs into the field and cries with a great voice.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς τρέχει εἰς τὸν ἀγρὸν καὶ κράζει μεγάλῃ φωνῇ.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer runs into the field and cries with a great voice.

panels.scene: Teaches: βάλλω — He throws stones at the wolf.
panels.greekCaption: βάλλει λίθους εἰς τὸν λύκον.
panels.englishCaption: He throws stones at the wolf.

panels.scene: Teaches: ὑπάγω, ἀπό — 'Go away from the field!'
panels.greekCaption: Ὕπαγε ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀγροῦ!
panels.englishCaption: 'Go away from the field!'

panels.scene: Teaches: φεύγω — The wolf flees from the lamb.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύκος φεύγει ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀρνίου.
panels.englishCaption: The wolf flees from the lamb.

panels.scene: Teaches: διώκω — The farmer pursues the wolf.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς διώκει τὸν λύκον.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer pursues the wolf.

panels.scene: Teaches: τέλος — Finally the wolf flees across the river.
panels.greekCaption: τέλος ὁ λύκος φεύγει πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: Finally the wolf flees across the river.

panels.scene: Reinforces: βλέπω — The farmer looks at his animals. All are safe.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς βλέπει τὰ ζῷα αὐτοῦ. πάντα σῴζεται.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer looks at his animals. All are safe.

panels.scene: Teaches: ὑπό — The farmer sits under the tree.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς καθίζει ὑπὸ τὸ δένδρον.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer sits under the tree.

panels.scene: Teaches: κύριος, δίκαιος — He gives thanks: 'O Lord, you are righteous and faithful.'
panels.greekCaption: εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ θεῷ· Ὦ κύριε, σὺ δίκαιος καὶ πιστός εἶ.
panels.englishCaption: He gives thanks: 'O Lord, you are righteous and faithful.'

panels.scene: Teaches: καλέω — The farmer calls the sheep and the lamb.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς καλεῖ τὰ πρόβατα καὶ τὸ ἀρνίον.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer calls the sheep and the lamb.

panels.scene: Teaches: γινώσκω — The sheep knows the voice of the farmer.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ πρόβατον γινώσκει τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ γεωργοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The sheep knows the voice of the farmer.

panels.scene: Reinforces: αἴρω, φέρω — The farmer lifts the lamb and carries it.
panels.greekCaption: αἴρει τὸ ἀρνίον καὶ φέρει αὐτό.
panels.englishCaption: He lifts the lamb and carries it.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἀκολουθέω — The sheep follows the farmer.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ πρόβατον ἀκολουθεῖ τῷ γεωργῷ.
panels.englishCaption: The sheep follows the farmer.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἄγω — The farmer leads his animals toward the house.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς ἄγει τὰ ζῷα πρὸς τὸν οἶκον.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer leads his animals toward the house.
